basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old creative professional from Portland, Oregon, who has been working in graphic design and animation for over a decade. I have a keen interest in animated series and love exploring different genres of music, particularly in show soundtracks. In my free time, I enjoy dabbling in digital art and gaming. Not much of a morning person, I am usually active online in the late evenings. I work as a freelance designer, which gives me some flexibility with my hours. Currently single, I enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, I have a solid foundation in visual arts and digital media. My passion for animation led me to self-teach various animation software and techniques. Over the years, I've worked on multiple projects that required knowledge of both traditional and digital art forms.
